name: 60fps
tagline: Delightful UI/UX animation details from the best apps
description: A reference library, not a component kit: thousands of short screen recordings of real product micro-interactions, tagged by pattern (bounce, stagger, spring physics, liquid glass) rather than by app, so you can compare how five different apps solved the same onboarding moment. Started in 2022 as a way to archive feature-launch trailers before they disappeared.
